data.title: Gardenia Bay
data.about:
Embrace balanced living at Gardenia Bay by Aldar, where sustainability intertwines with luxury, offering meticulously designed Studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments for future residents seeking harmony between modernity, nature, and responsible living. 

Set against the dynamic backdrop of Yas Island, this signature development from Aldar, the pinnacle of real estate lifestyle developers in Abu Dhabi, offers a unique and unmatched waterfront living experience. These homes, constructed with heartfelt consideration, cultivate a thriving community encapsulated in verdant surroundings.

characteristics_module.title: Meticulously selected natural materials for an authentic sense of place.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exceptionally balanced architectural ethos, merging nature with modernity.
  • Exclusive array of residences, from intimate studios to expansive three bedroom havens.
  • Effortless fusion of indoor elegance with outdoor verdancy.Immediate access to serene waterfront promenades and a vibrant beach club.
  • Community focused, tranquil living spaces set in lush natural landscapes.
  • Strategically positioned on Yas Island, offering swift access  to Abu Dhabi's and Dubai's urban luxuries.
  • Proximity to Yas Island’s tranquil parks and thrilling entertainment hubs.
  • Located in the heart of dynamic Abu Dhabi, teeming with cultural and contemporary vibrancy.
  • Unparalleled access to premium amenities including fitness, leisure, and retail experiences.

location_tile.title: Located on Yas Island, Gardenia Bay stands as a highlight of serene waterfront living in the vibrant setting of Abu Dhabi.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
This premier spot is surrounded by untouched natural scenery, providing a haven of peace in the midst of the city's lively pulse. Inhabitants have unparalleled proximity to globally acclaimed attractions like Warner Bros. World, SeaWorld, and the Etihad Arena, placing them at the epicenter of upscale relaxation and amusement. Merely a short walk from the verdant realms of Yas Gateway Park and the abundant shopping and gourmet pleasures of Yas Mall, Gardenia Bay meets a diverse array of living preferences. Its tactical location ensures extraordinary links to major city hubs in Abu Dhabi, seamlessly integrating work commitments with leisurely pleasure.

  • 5 Minutes to SeaWorld.
  • 5 Minutes to Ferrari World.
  • 8 Minutes to Yas Mall.
  • 12 Minutes to Yas Bay.
  • 15 Minutes to Abu Dhabi International Airport.
